landing.subtitle: Ensure flawless APA, MLA, and Chicago style precision in seconds. Our advanced AI scans, corrects, and formats your academic papers with rigorous accuracy.

landing.feat_title: Everything you need to stand out
landing.feat_subtitle: Next-generation tools designed for researchers and students.
landing.feat1_desc: Say goodbye to misplaced commas and periods in your bibliography.
landing.feat2_desc: What used to take hours is now solved in seconds.
landing.feat3_desc: Your documents are never shared or used to train other AIs.
landing.feat4_desc: Automatically create table of contents with the correct structure.
landing.faq_subtitle: We solve your doubts before starting.
landing.faq1_q: What happens if I run out of tokens?
landing.faq1_a: You can purchase additional Token Packs at any time without losing your progress.
landing.faq2_q: Can I cancel at any time?
landing.faq2_a: Yes, your subscription has no long-term contracts. Cancel whenever you want from your profile.
landing.faq3_q: What file formats do you support?
landing.faq3_a: Currently, to guarantee maximum precision and design respect, we only support documents in .docx format (Microsoft Word).
landing.faq4_q: What payment methods do you accept?
landing.faq4_a: We currently accept payments via PayPal (credit/debit cards) and Binance Pay (USDT crypto transfers).
